basic_details.job_title: DW&CW&EO Palnadu Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 4 Case Worker, Para Legal Personnel and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: District Women Child Welfare & Empowerment Office Palnadu (DW&CW&EO Palnadu) has announced 4 vacancies for Case Worker, Para Legal Personnel / Lawyer, and Paramedical personals posts on a contract basis under its 2026 recruitment. Eligible candidates can apply offline by submitting the prescribed application form by hand to the Office of the District Women & Child Welfare & Empowerment Officer, Palnadu District, on or before 20 October 2026. Qualifications and eligibility vary by post, and the notified monthly pay is Rs. 19,500 for Case Worker, Rs. 20,000 for Para Legal Personnel / Lawyer, and

qualification.details: Any woman having a Bachelor in Law / Social Work / Sociology / Social Science / Psychology with at least 3 years' experience of working on women related domains in a Government or Non-Government project/programme. Should preferably be a resident of the local community to utilize local human resources and expertise for effective functioning of the Centre. | In the absence of Legal Advisors provided by the District Legal Services Authority, the legal counseling services may be outsourced to any woman having a Degree in Law / legal training or knowledge of laws with at least 3 years of experience in a Government or Non-Government women-related project/programme at the district level, or to any practicing lawyer with at least 2 years of litigation experience in any court of law. | In the absence of regular Para Medical Personnel provided by the District Health Authorities, the medical assistance services may be outsourced to any woman having a professional Degree/Diploma in Paramedics with a background in the health sector and preferably with at least 3 years of experience in a Government or Non-Government health project/programme at the district level.

selection_process: Only qualified shortlisted candidates will be called for interview and top listed candidates shall be considered for selection.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Prospective female candidates must download the application form prescribed and submit the filled application form along with attested Xerox copies of education qualifications, mark lists, experience certificates, certificate in computers, study certificates up to 10th etc., by hand to the DW & CW & EO, Palnadu District from 13.10.2026 to 20.10.2026 from the date of publication of notification before 5.00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Any woman having a Bachelor in Law / Social Work / Sociology / Social Science / Psychology with at least 3 years' experience of working on women related domains in a Government or Non-Government project/programme. Should preferably be a resident of the local community to utilize local human resources and expertise for effective functioning of the Centre. In the absence of Legal Advisors provided by the District Legal Services Authority, the legal counseling services may be outsourced to any woman having a Degree in Law / legal training or knowledge of laws with at least 3 years of experience in a Government or Non-Government women-related project/programme at the district level, or to any practicing lawyer with at least 2 years of litigation experience in any court of law. In the absence of regular Para Medical Personnel provided by the District Health Authorities, the medical assistance services may be outsourced to any woman having a professional Degree/Diploma in Paramedics with a background in the health sector and preferably with at least 3 years of experience in a Government or Non-Government health project/programme at the district level.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Prescribed application form Attested Xerox copies of education qualifications Mark lists Experience certificates Certificate in computers Study certificates up to 10th standard

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Only qualified shortlisted candidates will be called for interview and top listed candidates shall be considered for selection.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies available under DW&CW&EO Palnadu Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 4 vacancies are available for Case Worker, Para Legal Personnel / Lawyer, and Paramedical personals posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the filled application form by hand is 20 October 2026 before 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for all posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for all posts is 25 to 44 years, with age relaxation provided as per the Government of Andhra Pradesh rules in force.

faq.question: Q4. What is the monthly salary for a Case Worker?
faq.answer: The notified monthly salary for a Case Worker is Rs. 19,500/- on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q5. Who is eligible to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Only female local candidates who meet the specific educational qualifications and experience criteria prescribed for each post are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee mentioned in the notification?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How should candidates submit their applications?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit the prescribed application form along with attested copies of required documents by hand to the Office of the District Women & Child Welfare & Empowerment Officer, Palnadu District.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection procedure for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates are selected through shortlisting of applications followed by an interview for qualified shortlisted candidates.
